user.title: Set up Filament Manager
user.description: Filament spools and boxes are added afterwards, from this integration's entry (the "+ Add" button).

user.title: Add a filament spool
user.description: What kind of spool is it?

details.title: Spool details
details.description: Total weight is suggested from the material/manufacturer you picked where known, otherwise a generic default - always editable. The maximum humidity is pre-filled to suit the material (e.g. 20% for Nylon, 50% for PLA).

data.humidity_sensor: Humidity sensor (optional, ignored if a filament box is selected above)
data.humidity_delay: Alert only after (minutes above the limit)

name.title: Name the spool
name.description: Suggested from the material, color and manufacturer you picked. Feel free to change it.

reconfigure.title: Edit spool
reconfigure.description: Update the spool's details. Use the remaining-weight entity or the consume_filament / refill_spool services to change how much filament is left.

data.name: Name
data.humidity_sensor: Humidity sensor (optional, ignored if a filament box is selected above)
data.humidity_delay: Alert only after (minutes above the limit)

error.name_required: Please enter a name for the spool.
error.remaining_exceeds_total: The remaining weight cannot be greater than the total weight.
error.box_full: This filament box is already full (max. 4 spools).

user.title: Add a filament box
user.description: A filament box groups up to 4 spools (e.g. a dry box) and can carry a single shared humidity sensor for all of them. Leave the limit and delay empty to use the values of the most sensitive material stored in the box.

reconfigure.title: Edit filament box
reconfigure.description: Update the box's name and humidity settings. Leave the limit and delay empty to use the values of the most sensitive material stored in the box.

error.name_required: Please enter a name for the box.

consume_filament.name: Consume filament
consume_filament.description: Reduces a spool's remaining weight by the given amount.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Amount of filament used, in grams.

refill_spool.name: Refill spool
refill_spool.description: Resets a spool's remaining weight, e.g. after mounting a fresh one.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: New remaining weight in grams. If left empty, the spool is reset to its total weight.
